abilities.name: stench
abilities.effect: Has a 10% chance of making target Pokémon flinch with each hit.

abilities.name: sticky-hold
abilities.effect: Prevents a held item from being removed by other Pokémon.

abilities.name: poison-touch
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of poisoning target Pokémon upon contact.

kanto.flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

original-johto.flavorText: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.

hoenn.flavorText: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

original-unova.flavorText: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

updated-unova.flavorText: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

kalos.flavorText: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: This Pokémon’s favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, Muk are certain to gather.

original-alola.flavorText: After recent environmental improvements, this Pokémon is now hardly seen at all. People speculate that it may go extinct at some point.

updated-alola.flavorText: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they’ve long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
